items.quote: And Abimelech said unto Abraham, What sawest thou, that thou hast done this thing?
items.claim: Abimelech asks Abraham what made him do 'this thing'. The passage itself doesn't say what the act was.

items.quote: And Abraham said, Because I thought, Surely the fear of God is not in this place; and they will slay me for my wife's sake.
items.claim: Abraham says he acted because he believed there was no fear of God in that place and that people there would kill him to get his wife.
items.object: fear of being slain for his wife's sake
items.mechanism: perceived absence of fear of God in the place, leading to expected lethal threat over his wife
